newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian Treasury raises two mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian Treasury raises two mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian treasury on Tuesday said it sold two million dinars of three-year notes at its weekly auction on Aug 27, repaying maturing paper totalling 5.5 million dinars.
The three-year note are payable in equal annual tranches at a 9.1250 percent yield.
Banks bidded for 36 million dinars for three, four and five-year notes at between 9.1250 and 9.5000 percent. ($=0.96 dinar)
